- Neuro oscillations were the first thing to be seen in human EEG

## How are these generated by neurons?
- PING - Pytamidal InterNeuron Gamma
- ![[Screenshot 2026-11-27 at 15.19.35.png]]
- These fire in synchronous waves.

## Spikes to signals 
- we need signal sampled at evenly spaced times
- for pop of N neurons, we calc the firing rate in a moving window with width w.
![[Screenshot 2026-11-27 at 15.23.26.png]]

## Fourier Transform
- Any signal can be written as a sum of oscillations of different frequencies f. ![[Screenshot 2026-11-27 at 15.28.43.png]]
- Signals are combinations of sine waves.![[Screenshot 2026-11-27 at 15.29.36.png]]
- Two limits of Fourier transform
	- Resolution: frequencies are Fs/N = 1/T apart
	- Nyquist: the highest frequency we can see is Fs/2
